resource_filename_change: JEI/Minecraft 1.11 resources use lowercase locale filenames such as en_us.lang instead of legacy mixed-case names such as en_US.lang.
notes: The pinned JEI 4.1.1 en_us.lang is byte-identical to JEI 3.14.8 en_US.lang (Git blob 75790131d753d64fe0cf98f3ac5c0ee67f6bd545). G7 therefore requires no semantic retranslation of existing JEI strings; work is limited to Minecraft language-scope changes, lowercase resource naming and exact upstream ownership changes.
